Chapter 149. Hyran's Light, or (2)
He must have cried for about an hour.
If he could, Dante wanted to cry here until his life ended. He wanted to disappear, embraced by the light like the smile his grandfather used to show in his lifetime, like his bosom.
If he had nothing left.
Neither the family, those who fought for the family, a friend who ran a whole month leaving everything behind, his people, the land he had to protect, and even himself.
If everything had really disappeared, Dante might not have been able to stand up again.
But that much was left.
And the reason that much could be left was the cost of his grandfather sacrificing his life. He literally sacrificed everything...
"I can't afford to hesitate."
Dante wiped his eyes and looked back at Jin.
"I'm sorry for making you wait so long."
It was a month since the two met. Dante needed time, and Jin received intensive healing while he was unconscious for over two weeks.
He didn't get any additional injuries thanks to Ron's protection during the escape, but the accumulated shock was too great.
Dante finally made up his mind today. He decided not to be immersed in sorrow anymore. That's why he came here.
To say goodbye to his grandfather with Jin. Not an eternal farewell as Ron left it, but to say hello to move forward.
Now, Dante had to inherit the duty of guardianship that Ron had taken on.
However, Jin, in fact, was unable to take a step like Dante. Because the guilt, still like a rusted piece of iron, was heavily pressing on Jin's heart.
"I know what you're thinking."
The moment Jin opened his mouth, Dante spoke first.
At the time of the war, the last moment Ron sent the two out of the path of light. Dante was able to receive Ron's will, which Jin did not notice.
"He told me that there was no fault of yours. He said it to both you and me."
It wasn't just Jin who was suffering from guilt. Dante also had a hard time overcoming the thought that he lost his grandfather because, in his heart, he didn't protect anything himself.
How many people died to save him, and how much was broken.
"We did well enough. Maybe we couldn't do any better."
Like a leaf catching fire, Jin's eyes moistened. This time Dante turned his head to avoid Jin's crying face.
"There's just an inevitable sadness. So, it's best to forget everything that hasn't happened yet."
Dante was speaking as if he knew about Jin's regression.
It was because he had found out that fact just before Ron became light. Dante had a vague glimpse of the secret that Jin held from his will.
He didn't know clearly, but he knew that the guilt his friend held was related to that secret.
And even knowing all that at the moment of his death, Ron conveyed so. That neither his grandson nor Jin had done anything wrong. Because it really was so.
"Reveal your secret when the time comes, like Lord Beradin did."
Another friend who is not here.
Jin and Dante felt grateful to him. They now knew the fact that Beradin had sacrificed himself for his friend.
It was thanks to the letter that Sandra sent secretly.
(Dear Jin! Hello? I'm writing this letter today to schedule our next date! And I guess I should tell you.
You didn't know that our Radin exerted his power to prevent all the main houses from attacking the Black Emperor, did you?
I can't tell you in detail, but he decided to risk his life to help himself and his friend. Isn't it admirable? To go so far to support this sister's love! It's so great, I could die.
Anyway, without Radin, this fight would definitely have been harder.
Congratulations on your victory. Our family is in a funeral atmosphere, but I think what's good for me is the best.

Although my brother almost died, and I almost got killed by Kadun for continuously urging to help Jin rather than suppress the chaos, and I've been lectured by Hedo for days, and I'm about to explode because of resource recovery.
Haha, don't feel too pressured. It's a problem that can be solved with just one date. You know what I mean, right? I'll be waiting. - Your one and only love, Sandra Zifel)
The letter was somewhat confusing, but it was enough to turn the guess that Beradin was helping them into certainty.
"…But are you really dating Sandra Zifel? The glory of the pergola then."
"It's enough nonsense with Sandra Zifel, Dante."
The two burst into a chuckle.
"It would have been nice if Lord Beradin was here too. People think I will resent him because Zifel attacked the Black Emperor, but not at all. He is my friend, whenever, wherever."
Even if Beradin were to lose his ego to mental manipulation and turn into a monster someday, and therefore attack him, Dante was ready not to hate him.
That was his form of trust, his degree. Despite such great sorrow and pain, he neither became a vengeful spirit like in the first battle, nor fell into madness.
The solid and shining heart of a human being named Dante Hyran is maintaining its original form. Just as his grandfather ultimately overcame demonization.
"Let's create an opportunity to meet him soon."
"You talk as if you're going somewhere."
"Yes, I'm going. To train."
"When?"
"Not immediately. After sorting out the situation and handling a few things."
Going to Lafrarosa to achieve 10-star was already planned, but the weakening of Zhipl and Runkandel was particularly advantageous for Jin.
'Surely there will be a truce, so the possibility of my colleagues being threatened while I'm absent has drastically decreased.'
Even if the truce breaks during his training, the Barmel Coalition was a force that could not be protected even by Runkandel now.
Although it cannot be said to be entirely Runkandel's power, it was because they were Jin's people.
Jin has further consolidated his position as the next head of the family through this incident, and the moment he becomes the head, the Barmel Coalition will become Runkandel's power.
More than anything, people were precious now more than ever when the power of the giant families was weakened.
There was no reason not to maintain a friendly relationship with the Barmel Coalition, which was emerging as the fifth power following Zhipl, Runkandel, Empire, and Kinzelro.
"How long do you think it will take?"
"Talaris said it won't be a long training, but I think we'll have to see."
"You're going to get stronger again."
"Now, it's my turn to follow you."
Dante bowed his head.
"Not to that extent. Although my grandfather has passed on the energy, it seems to take a long time to become my full power."
"Besides, what are you going to do?"
It was a question about the Empire.
The throne of the Empire is currently vacant. Although the Emperor has not officially retired from the throne, it was impossible for him to rule the Empire again.

As the whole story of the incident was revealed, the public sentiment literally plummeted, Zhipl did not receive what he promised from him, and Runkandel and Bi-Gung also suffered a significant blow from his and Zhipl's decisions.
Therefore, despite the scarcity of talents, the giant powers did not covet the empire that had become a public property.
He died as soon as he reached the black star of the strongest empire, and most of the top figures of the empire, including the Empire's two swords, Joncina Ferrel, also died in this war.

Moreover, taking over the Empire now only increased the headache. Which land was most contaminated by the chaos of Glic? Whoever swallowed the empire had to bear and purify the contaminated area in full.

"The Emperor cannot be spared. Apart from personal hatred and revenge, he has caused irreparable damage to the Empire. And the throne, I will take charge of it for the time being. In a form of ruling with a puppet."
"Haven't you considered just ascending to the throne yourself? If legitimacy is a problem..."
"Since the birth of the Empire, the royal family has never received more love from the people than the Hyrans. There is an abundance of legitimacy and reason."
"So why?"
Then Dante slowly drew Rashid.
"This sword does not exist to rule. The reason Rashid was forged is to protect this land. As my grandfather and ancestors did, I will not forget my duty. Instead."
Dante turned his head to Jin.

"When the empire gets back on track, ask for a favor. To King Casimir of the Barmel Alliance, the Tikan Free State. Ask him to ascend the throne. By then, I will step back from governing and become the Sword Emperor again. That's the conclusion I've made."
"Having King Casimir in charge of the empire you restored is no different than saying the empire is my land, Dante."
"All the people of the empire know that you fought for us until the end. And, don't they know well enough that your power will still be needed in the empire?"
Dante was sincere. He believed he couldn't continue to protect the empire alone with his power.

"Amir Bement may be dead, but there will be other cards left in the royal family. I could negotiate with Zieff again, or maybe it could be Kinzelor or Runecandel. Even if not, once the restoration of the polluted area is over, the major powers will target the empire again. Who should I trust in such a situation?"
Jin couldn't refute, feeling uncomfortable about taking what's Dante's.
"It's only you. There is Veradin, but he is always exposed to threats. So, unashamedly, I ask for your favor in the future."
Jin shook hands with Dante.
Then Dante took out a bottle of liquor and three glasses from his pocket. The bottle was intact, but all the glasses were broken or cracked.
Those glasses were the pottery that Lon cherished.
From the broken shack beyond the plains of the Sword Emperor, Dante had found them himself.

"In the wreckage of the shack where my grandfather used to play with me when I was a child, there were a few pieces of pottery left miraculously. I picked the most intact ones, glued them together, and brought them. With the medicinal liquor my grandfather used to enjoy."
Pong...
As Dante uncorked the bottle, he looked at the ground.
The black land where they sat was gradually regaining its original color.
Lon's light was purifying the contaminated territory of the Sword Emperor.
Very slowly, and slowly.
As always with purification, it will surely be perfectly purified someday.
One glass in front of Lon's light, one in his own glass, and one for Jin.
Dante and Jin raised their glasses to Lon's light.
Let's have a drink with my lovely grandson after the fight is over, Jin remembered what Lon had said.
After slowly emptying the glass, the two got up from their seats. And before they left, they each drew out their swords and engraved these words under Lon's light.
Sword Emperor Lon Hiran.
Here Hiran's light, or the light of the world, became.
'Goodbye, Grandfather.'
Leaving the territory, Dante had a soft smile like that light.
